text:
## Step 1: Risk Classify Before Activation  
1. Identify whether the applicant is an individual or entity.
2. Apply the standard customer-risk assessment.
3. Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`.
4. Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass.
name: Chunk 3/6

raw_entities.name: Risk Classification Before Account Activation
raw_entities.description: An end-to-end procedure that classifies customer risk before account activation. The process identifies applicant type, applies standard risk assessment, flags high-risk customers for enhanced due diligence, and enforces approval gates before credential issuance or deposit acceptance.
context: Risk Classify Before Activation
Identify whether the applicant is an individual or entity
Apply the standard customer-risk assessment
Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`
Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: Applicant Type Identification
raw_entities.description: The first step in risk classification where the responsible actor determines whether the applicant is an individual or an entity. This classification determines which risk assessment rules apply.
context: Identify whether the applicant is an individual or entity

raw_entities.name: Standard Customer Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: The step where standard customer-risk assessment criteria are applied to the applicant based on their identified type. This assessment determines the customer's risk classification.
context: Apply the standard customer-risk assessment

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Flagging
raw_entities.description: The step where customers identified as high-risk are marked as 'Pending Enhanced Due Diligence'. This flag prevents account activation until enhanced due diligence is completed and approved.
context: Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`

raw_entities.name: Approval Gate Verification Before Activation
raw_entities.description: The final step that enforces approval gates before credentials are issued or initial deposits are accepted. This step ensures all compliance and risk checks have passed before account activation.
context: Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer Gate
raw_entities.description: A branching decision point where the customer's risk assessment outcome determines whether they proceed to standard activation or are flagged for enhanced due diligence. High-risk customers are held pending approval; standard-risk customers proceed.
context: Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`
Apply the standard customer-risk assessment

raw_entities.name: Approval Gates Pass Decision
raw_entities.description: A gate decision that determines whether all approval conditions have been satisfied before credentials are issued and deposits are accepted. Failure to pass gates blocks account activation.
context: Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: Risk Classification Assessor
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for identifying applicant type, applying standard risk assessment, and marking high-risk customers for enhanced due diligence during the pre-activation risk classification process.
context: Identify whether the applicant is an individual or entity
Apply the standard customer-risk assessment
Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`

raw_entities.name: Approval Gate Authority
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for verifying that all approval gates have passed before credentials are issued or initial deposits are accepted. This role enforces the activation authorization decision.
context: Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Compliance Gate
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance gate that verifies enhanced due diligence requirements have been satisfied for high-risk customers before account activation is permitted. This checkpoint ensures regulatory risk management obligations are met.
context: Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`
Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: Applicant
raw_entities.description: The natural person or entity applying for an account who is subject to risk classification before activation. The applicant's type (individual or entity) and risk profile determine the activation pathway.
context: Identify whether the applicant is an individual or entity
Apply the standard customer-risk assessment
Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: A customer identified through standard risk assessment as presenting elevated compliance or financial crime risk. High-risk customers are flagged as 'Pending Enhanced Due Diligence' and cannot proceed to account activation until enhanced due diligence is completed and approved.
context: Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`
Do not issue credentials or accept an initial deposit until approval gates pass

raw_entities.name: Standard Customer Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: The KYC-related risk assessment process applied to all applicants to determine their risk classification. This assessment is a prerequisite to account activation and determines whether enhanced due diligence is required.
context: Apply the standard customer-risk assessment
Mark a high-risk customer as `Pending Enhanced Due Diligence`
